ic_name: AMBA AXI4-Stream Protocol (ARM IHI 0051, Single Unidirectional Stream Channel)

test_modes.name: BFM / VIP stimulus
test_modes.purpose: AXI4-Stream master/slave verification IP drive and check the handshake, byte types, packets, and routing in simulation.

test_modes.name: Protocol assertion checking
test_modes.purpose: Simulation-time assertions verify handshake legality and byte-type rules.

test_modes.name: On-chip signal capture
test_modes.purpose: Logic-analyzer / signal-capture of the T-signals for in-system debug.

spec_provided_observability.name: TVALID/TREADY handshake
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Observable transfer and backpressure timing for bring-up and protocol checking.

spec_provided_observability.name: TLAST
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Observable packet boundaries; mismatched TLAST indicates a framing error.

spec_provided_observability.name: TKEEP/TSTRB byte typing
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Observable byte types (data/position/null); the illegal TKEEP=0,TSTRB=1 is a checkable violation.

spec_provided_observability.name: TID/TDEST
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Observable stream id / routing for verifying interconnect routing and per-stream ordering.

spec_provided_observability.name: TUSER
spec_provided_observability.purpose: User-defined sideband can carry debug/marker information.

error_detection_mechanisms: Protocol checkers verify the TVALID/TREADY handshake rules (TVALID holds until TREADY; master does not wait for TREADY; payload stable).
Illegal byte qualifier TKEEP=0,TSTRB=1 is detectable.
Packet-framing checks: TLAST placement vs expected packet length.
Routing checks: TDEST selects the expected destination; per-TID order preserved.
Reset behavior check: TVALID must be LOW while ARESETn is LOW.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: TLAST HIGH on the last transfer of a packet.
TUSER marks start-of-frame in video-style use.

notes: AXI4-Stream's protocol-level test surface is the observability of the T-signals and the checkable handshake/byte-type/framing/routing rules. There is no in-band register access (the interface is addressless); chip-level scan/BIST remain device/SoC concerns.
